build_scratch_layer: build a scratch module with Conv2d layers from input and output channel shapes
create_residual_conv_unit: create a ResidualConvUnit with configurable features, activation, and batch normalization
create_feature_fusion_block: create a FeatureFusionBlock that fuses and upsamples multi-scale features with residual connections
test_ResidualConvUnit_forward: test the ResidualConvUnit forward pass with a sample tensor input
test_FeatureFusionBlock_forward: test the FeatureFusionBlock forward pass with one or two input feature tensors
